entities.name: Thraximundar
entities.description: Seven-foot-tall spiked undead dark knight from Grixis who leads swarms of undead across Alara; Nicol Bolas lets him run wild.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon planeswalker who disguised himself as a pale black-haired boy to spread terror and open Antoris's wall, feeding the Maelstrom.

entities.name: The Boy
entities.description: Illusion of a pale, scrawny black-haired child created by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Breot
entities.description: Chieftain of the Riftclan Tol Breot who keeps his sick clansmen together; cut down by Thraximundar.

entities.name: Riftclan Tol Breot
entities.description: Jund warrior clan flung to Grixis and slaughtered by Thraximundar's undead.

entities.name: Sonara
entities.description: Young mother of the Riftclan who asks the boy where he is from.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Planeswalker and warrior-mage whose victory at Tower Stele is celebrated in Bant; the boy claims she is dead, but she is not.

entities.name: Lifris
entities.description: Esper arcanist on guard duty at the spell-wall of Antoris who lets the boy in.

entities.name: Elleta
entities.description: Wife of a blacksmith from the ruins of Giltspire.

entities.name: Antoris
entities.description: Esper city that has emerged on the side of a volcano in Jund and is besieged by dragons.

entities.name: Tower Stele
entities.description: Site of a battle in which Elspeth decimated an army of Grixis invaders.

entities.name: Sun-Dappled Court
entities.description: Bant destination toward which refugees are headed.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard of Alara to which Elspeth is expected to lead aid.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Home shard of the Riftclan Tol Breot.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard where Antoris originates.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Hellish shard from which Thraximundar comes.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Jungle shard toward which Thraximundar sweeps.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane now merged into one landscape.

entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: Magical force that expands with more energy with each life taken.

entities.name: Balmgivers of Topa
entities.description: Healers from Topa who bring food and healers to Bant's refugees.

events.summary: The Riftclan Tol Breot is blasted from Jund into Grixis, loses half its clan, and is attacked by rot-skinned ogres.
events.quote: The Riftclan Tol Breot was lost in an unfamiliar land.

events.summary: Breot decides to keep the sick survivors together instead of leaving them behind.
events.quote: But Breot made the unexpected decision to keep all the survivors together and nurse the sick.

events.summary: A pale black-haired boy arrives at the camp and warns the Riftclan to flee; Breot refuses.
Thraximundar charges over the ridge with swarms of undead and cuts Breot down before he can raise his sword; the undead engulf the clan.
events.quote: Leading swarms of undead, Thraximundar charged down the hill and cut Breot down before the chieftain could raise his sword or utter a single word.

events.summary: Refugees heading to the Sun-Dappled Court hear that a warrior-mage at Tower Stele destroyed an army of the hellish invaders and expect her to slay Thraximundar.
events.quote: A warrior-mage decimated an entire army of the hellish invaders !

events.summary: Balmgivers from Topa reach the refugees with food and healers, and Elspeth's name is spoken as Bant's hope.
events.quote: That night, the name Elspeth was spoken around campfires and inside healing tents.

events.summary: The boy tells a blacksmith's family that Elspeth threw herself on a pyre and scattered her essence to the winds.
events.quote: "She threw herself on a pyre and scattered her essence to the winds," the boy replied.

events.summary: Dragons besiege Antoris City, which sits on a volcano; the mage council works together and pools etherium.
Lifris lets the boy in, and the boy opens a rift in the spell-wall after warning of wickedness to come.
events.quote: When he was gone, the boy tapped the wall with his grubby finger, and a tiny rift opened in the shimmering barrier.

events.summary: Bolas reveals himself as the boy, drops the illusion and flies off as Antoris is destroyed and Thraximundar sweeps toward Naya; Elspeth is not really dead but will trouble him no more in Alara.
events.quote: The dragon let his illusion of the little boy evaporate into the acrid air and resumed his natural shape.

relations.note: Cut Breot down on the ridge.
relations.quote: cut Breot down before the chieftain could raise his sword or utter a single word
The clan's chief, Breot, wouldn't let them eat the dead ogres
The dragon let his illusion of the little boy evaporate into the acrid air

relations.note: Bolas calls Thraximundar a beautiful creation and nudges him as he pleases.
relations.quote: Thraximundar was such a beautiful creation, so perfectly suited to mindless carnage

relations.note: Bolas lets him run wild with a gentle nudge.
relations.quote: Nicol Bolas didn't mind letting him run wild as he pleased

relations.note: She would cause him no more trouble in Alara.
relations.quote: she would cause him no more trouble in Alara

relations.note: Antoris has emerged on a volcano in Jund.
relations.quote: their city hadn't emerged on the side of a volcano
